work: Cue3D: Quantifying the Role of Image Cues in Single-Image 3D Generation
task_and_design: Known-GT objects; controlled perturbations of style, shading, texture, silhouette, edges, perspective, and continuity
models_or_scale: 7 models; 412 GSO and 500 Toys4K objects; six artistic styles
metrics_or_evidence: CD, F-score, multi-view appearance, visible-surface quality, symmetry
overlap_with_current_A: Very high: same-object controlled style shifts, known GT, multiple model families, and Hunyuan3D-2
remaining_difference: Does not foreground volume/topology or formally test metric validity against asset utility
decision: Blocks cross-model style robustness as the main novelty

work: Unveiling limitations of 3D object reconstruction models through a novel benchmark
task_and_design: 3DCoMPaT++ benchmark with changing viewpoints and varying 2D styles; part-level analysis
overlap_with_current_A: Very high: known 3D data, multiple models, style variation, benchmark framing
remaining_difference: Uses older reconstruction families and does not study modern image-to-3D asset metrics
decision: Blocks claims of first paired cross-style benchmark

work: A Semi-Automated Framework for 3D Reconstruction of Medieval Manuscript Miniatures
task_and_design: Real artistic figures from two manuscript collections; cross-model image-to-3D comparison
metrics_or_evidence: Silhouette IoU, LPIPS, CLIP, depth-range ratio, watertight percentage, 2AFC human study
overlap_with_current_A: High: artistic inputs, modern multi-model comparison, volumetric and topology diagnostics
remaining_difference: No 3D ground truth and no same-object counterfactual style pairing
decision: Blocks claims of first volumetric/topology audit on artistic inputs

work: Art3D: Training-Free 3D Generation from Flat-Colored Illustration
task_and_design: Training-free correction for flat-colored illustrations and Flat-2D benchmark
models_or_scale: More than 100 flat images; several image-to-3D baselines
metrics_or_evidence: Qualitative and task-specific evaluation of corrected 3D assets
overlap_with_current_A: High for flat-colour and hand-drawing claims
remaining_difference: Mitigation paper rather than a causal metric audit with known 3D GT
decision: Blocks broad artistic-input novelty and flat-colour-only framing

work: Multi-Dimensional Quality Assessment for Single-Image-to-3D Contents: Dataset and Model
task_and_design: Reference-based perceptual quality assessment for realistic, AI-generated, and CG inputs
metrics_or_evidence: Texture fidelity, shape accuracy, overall quality; learned I3DQA evaluator
overlap_with_current_A: High for claims about missing asset-quality evaluation
remaining_difference: No controlled style counterfactuals and no 3D GT metric-validity analysis
decision: Requires any new metric study to compare against human-aligned QA literature

work: SI23DCQA: Perceptual Quality Assessment of Single Image-to-3D Content
task_and_design: Human quality database for realistic, AI-generated, and model-rendered inputs
metrics_or_evidence: Human ratings for shape, colour, and overall quality; NR-IQA/VQA/3DQA baselines
remaining_difference: No known 3D GT and no controlled style pairing
decision: Human evaluation alone is not a novel contribution

work: Eval3D: Interpretable and Fine-grained Evaluation for 3D Generation
task_and_design: Fine-grained automatic evaluation of semantic, structural, and geometric consistency
metrics_or_evidence: Foundation-model probes, pixel-wise spatial feedback, human alignment
overlap_with_current_A: Medium-high for the claim that conventional metrics miss geometry
decision: A metric-validity pivot must benchmark against or clearly distinguish Eval3D

work: 3DGen-Bench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for 3D Generative Models
task_and_design: Human-preference benchmark for text-to-3D and image-to-3D
overlap_with_current_A: Medium for broad evaluation and human-alignment claims
decision: Blocks broad claims of first human-aligned image-to-3D evaluation

work: Spectrum AUC Difference (SAUCD): Human-aligned 3D Shape Evaluation
task_and_design: Reference-based mesh shape evaluation sensitive to global shape and local detail
models_or_scale: Shape Grading dataset; more than 800 subjects
metrics_or_evidence: Spectral mesh distance calibrated to human judgements
overlap_with_current_A: Medium-high for proposing a new geometry metric
decision: Any metric-validity study should include SAUCD rather than inventing an unsupported score

work: DB-3DME: From Dataset to Benchmark for Human-aligned Automatic 3D Mesh Evaluation
metrics_or_evidence: VLM benchmarking and a fine-tuned evaluator across multiple dimensions
overlap_with_current_A: Medium for mesh-utility and human-alignment claims
remaining_difference: Not conditioned on input style or known source geometry
decision: Further narrows room for a generic mesh-evaluator contribution

work: PAniC-3D: Stylized Single-View 3D Reconstruction From Portraits of Anime Characters
task_and_design: Specialized illustration-to-3D reconstruction for anime portraits
models_or_scale: 11.2k 3D models and 1k portrait illustrations; AnimeRecon benchmark
overlap_with_current_A: Medium for stylized reconstruction as a general problem
remaining_difference: Domain-specific character heads, not generic object counterfactuals
decision: Blocks claims that stylized single-view reconstruction itself is unexplored

work: 3D Photo Stylization: Learning to Generate Stylized Novel Views From a Single Image
task_and_design: 3D-consistent stylized novel-view synthesis from one image
models_or_scale: Stylized image inputs and style-transfer outputs
metrics_or_evidence: Shows monocular depth estimation failure on stylized images
overlap_with_current_A: Medium for the mechanism linking style to lost depth cues
remaining_difference: Novel-view stylization rather than modern mesh generation
decision: Blocks broad mechanistic claims that stylization-induced depth failure is newly observed
